# Isomux

> Isomux is an open-source meta-harness for managing Claude, Codex, and OpenCode agents side by side.

## Documentation

- [Isomux documentation](https://isomux.com/docs): Feature index and product guide
- [Isomux developer API resources](https://isomux.com/docs/developer-api): API authentication, errors, and machine-readable references
- [Self-hosted installation](https://isomux.com/docs/self-hosted): Local, own-hardware, and VPS installation and operation
- [Access and invites](https://isomux.com/docs/access-and-invites): Browser authentication and access control
- [Agent safety hooks](https://isomux.com/docs/safety-hooks): Scope, evidence, and limits of agent safety guardrails
- [Security audit](https://isomux.com/docs/security-audit): Security model and findings

## Hosted Isomux policies

- [Terms of Service](https://isomux.com/hosted-terms): Terms for Hosted Isomux
- [Privacy Policy](https://isomux.com/hosted-privacy): Data collection, access, and retention for Hosted Isomux
- [Refund Policy](https://isomux.com/hosted-refund): Refund eligibility and requests for Hosted Isomux

## Machine-readable resources

- [Isomux OpenAPI specification](https://isomux.com/openapi.json): Website API contract
- [Sitemap](https://isomux.com/sitemap.xml): Public page index
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/nmamano/isomux): Source, issues, and releases
